name: binomial
description: Representative upstream schema: aten::binomial(Tensor count, Tensor prob, Generator? generator=None) -> Tensor. Draws binomial samples without mutating or aliasing count or prob. Tests cover output metadata and bounds, distribution moments, varying parameters, deterministic probability/count boundaries, generator reproducibility and state advancement, input preservation, and the separately registered binomial.out buffer identity contract retained in the shared pytest family.
